title: Deploy
explain: Deploying means running your binary on a server that other people can reach. Many hosts, such as Google Cloud Run and Render, tell your app which port to use through the `PORT` environment variable. Keep configuration like that in the environment, not in your code.
exercise: Run your server with `PORT=9000 go run .` and confirm it answers on port 9000.
tip: Listen on `:PORT`, not `localhost:PORT`. A server bound to localhost inside a container can't be reached from outside.
